Quote: "These companies have also provided access and tokens, which we use for evaluations, research, and engineering."
Explanation: The preceding sentence names OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta and Amazon. METR reports no AI-company funding while disclosing substantial free tokens; we count those as in-kind support. The disclosure is organization-wide.

Source: https://metr.org/blog/2026-06-26-gpt-5-6-sol/
Quote: "This evaluation was conducted under a standard NDA."
Quote: "For this evaluation, OpenAI provided:
• Access to GPT-5.6 Sol with raw chain-of-thought via API"
Explanation: The post concerns a nonpublic TH1.1 evaluation. OpenAI required communication/legal review and could block conclusions based on nonpublic information. METR says the review did not change its conclusions or tone. This supports privileged access and another material tie.
